# Publish gate report

**Going out:** Subscriber email to Priya, "Your October tins are on the way". Approver: Sam (marketing lead).

**Checks**
- **Claims:** "pause or cancel any time" matches the allowlist (subscription terms). "Left Bristol this morning" and the two teas (smoky lapsang, soft white peony) are operational or product facts, so they're fine as written. No stats, superlatives, guarantees, testimonials or urgency.
- **Regulated claims:** Nothing on health, money, environment, children or prices.
- **Disclosure:** This is the brand's own transactional email, so no label is needed.
- **House style:** "Elevate" is on the banned list. "Elevate your mornings:" is also a stock marketing opener that adds nothing, so the line fails.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite)**
- Removed "Elevate your mornings:" and kept the facts as they were.

> Subject: Your October tins are on the way
>
> Hi Priya,
>
> Your subscription box left Bristol this morning. This month it's a smoky lapsang and a soft white peony. If you're away next month, you can pause or cancel any time from your account.
>
> The Pebblebrook team

**Needs a decision**
- The subject says "October" and the body says "this month", but today is 17 November. Please confirm this is the right month's box, or change the wording. I haven't changed it, as I can't verify the shipment.
- Sam needs to approve the final text above. The version as submitted shouldn't go out.

**Evidence log rows**
| Date | Content | Claim | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-17 | October subscriber email | Subscribers can pause or cancel any time | On policy list | Subscription terms |
| 2026-11-17 | October subscriber email | Box left Bristol this morning | Operational fact, needs confirming | Operations |
